periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Approximately 45-60 degrees downward relative to the horizontal facial axis towards the snout.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Distinctly elongated oval with an estimated 2:1 length-to-width ratio.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering with the lowest point extending significantly below the eye's horizontal midline.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Wide, shallow U-shape with a relatively straight posterior boundary across the spine.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: High thickness, occupying approximately one-third of the total visible torso length.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Clear separation gap approximately equal to the transverse width of the upper cranium.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smoothly convex and rounded semicircular profile at the superior boundaries.

other_distinctive_markers: The typically white regions of the pelage exhibit a pervasive brownish-tan discoloration, most prominent on the posterior and ventral areas.
